entries.title: Back up your wallet BEFORE installing this update — one last time.
entries.text: This version gives PaperTrench a permanent identity, so future updates never wipe your wallet, whatever folder you load them from. But this one update still looks like a brand-new install: open the old version's popup → Setup → Backup wallet first; then unzip the update over the same folder and fully restart Chrome (this one time the reload button alone leaves PaperTrench looking dead); then restore the file from the card that opens.

entries.title: Automatic take profit / stop loss after every buy, plus trailing stops (Settings → Exits).
entries.text: Off by default; buying more re-bases them on your average entry; legs the price already passed are skipped, never fired. A trailing stop ratchets up with the highest price your coin actually reaches and fills at the real market price when it triggers — never at the level you set.

entries.title: Trade open positions from the dashboard.
entries.text: Every row now shows the live price and has Sell / Buy / Chart buttons. A dashboard fill needs two independent price sources to agree within 3% and books the less favourable one, so the dashboard can never beat the chart.

entries.title: GMGN: trade prints from thin or stale pools can no longer move the price.
entries.text: Each print is now tied to the pool it came from; prints from pools other than the dominant one must match its price within 3% while it is still trading, or they are ignored.

entries.title: Fixed: after a take-profit, stop-loss or trailing-stop exit, the next manual buy on that coin could refuse for a few seconds.
entries.text: The exit's own fill is now counted as fresh market evidence, so re-buying works right away.
